seal.statement: A partition write that is rerouted or retried after an honest 'outcome unknown' answer must apply exactly once and answer the client the truth. Today (integrated head 7e08cefcd, round-5 r5-g2-dup and round-7 evidence): the distributed write coordinator mints a per-plan participant entryId, but the transport query reply (partition-service-entry-apply-base.js handleRemoteQuery) drops failureCode, retryAfterMs, consensus and entryId, so every remote consumer is text-only by construction; the query executor's system-table widening (query-executor-write-retry-routing.js:462,540), the CDC routed-mutation loop, the CDC local lane and the rebalancer mutation loops re-issue a write under a fresh identity, so an UPDATE released as outcome_unknown is applied twice on every replica and an INSERT answers a constraint error although the row exists; a replay reaches the client as success with changes 0; SQLQueryEngine drops a client-supplied idempotencyKey; the admin write receipt marks a replayed answer complete only when the answering replica claims leadership (F-w); the control-plane classifier does not walk participantResults and treats the post-commit environmental application failure as failed-for-good (F-as, F-at). After this quest: the write identity is minted at exactly one boundary per path (the engine for client statements; once per logical mutation for the CDC and rebalancer loops) and carried unchanged on every reroute or retry; the partition answers a same-entryId retry from the durable outcome row (idempotentReplay, the original affected-row count); write answers cross the wire whole, and reroute admission is by the kernel's code predicate with carriesEntryId, with no text fallback for a partition answer; the admin receipt binds a replayed answer by (partitionId, entryId, term, logIndex) and the replay flag; the classifier walks participant results and lists the post-commit environmental failure with the not-failed-for-good answers; the registry names every consumer of the write-answer classification.

text: Found while writing the red witnesses (out of scope, owner src/query SQLParser): an expression in UPDATE SET (value || '+', n + 1, value || ?) is parsed to a literal NULL and the engine sends UPDATE ... SET value = NULL, answering success with affectedRows 1 - silent data corruption (R07). Also: only INSERT success answers keep durableCommitWitness (query-executor-sql-command-rendering.js:359), so an UPDATE receipt can never be complete; a deterministic constraint failure after a leader redirect is re-sent until the client budget expires (480 deliveries in 12 s). These are recorded for the owner and are not absorbed here.
